NO specific heat in this catalog; the existing Mix heatCapacity values (454, 587.3, 499.1, ...) were not found in any Micrometals document I could reach.

provenance.verificationMethod: Sheet "CurveFit", Version 2026-03-30. key "default" = row Material 8 / PartType T,E / Init. Perm. 35: %perm vs DC bias, %perm vs peak AC flux density, perm vs frequency, perm vs temperature, core loss. Default key = toroid row. Stored mu 35, Bsat 1.76357 T (column "Bsat(G)" 17635.69 G), density 6500 kg/m3 (column "Density(g/cm³)" 6.5). Stored coefficients are the workbook ones converted to SI and equal them to 4+ significant figures: %perm vs DC bias b x (4pi/1000)^c (H in A/m); core loss a x1e-15, b x1e-12.2, c x1e-9.6, d x1e11 (B in T, W/m3); %perm vs AC flux b x1e4^c, d x1e4^e; frequency and temperature coefficients unchanged. The workbook states no temperature for Bsat; the 100 C attached to the stored saturation point is not from this source.

Datasheet "Mix-08 (35µ)", header "Revision 20190524 - Generated 2019-May-24": mu(reference) 35; Bsat 17.6 kG; density 6.5 g/cm3; core loss vs Bpk and f fit (a=1.90E+09, b=2.00E+08, c=9.00E+05, d=5.00E-15); %perm vs DC bias fit (a=1.00E-02, b=3.49E-06, c=1.43, d=0.00); %perm vs peak AC flux density fit (a=3.50E+02, b=3.78E-01, c=1.03E+00, d=1.76E+10, e=-1.98E+00, f=1.40E+02); perm vs frequency fit (a=1.27E-01, b=1.98E-07, c=6.64E-01, d=2.70E+01); perm vs temperature fit (a=255).
